findings.reason: without the RULE for a condition that spans kinds, the worker must either invent a union semantics §6 does not state or duplicate the note across two entries §7 does not authorise, and either choice changes what §6 is.
findings.text: §7 says each sentence goes in "the `note` of a conditioned template (§6) whose conditions name exactly that combination", but the total-density sentence must render on `total_electron_density` (aggregation=total, aggregations.yml) and on `thermal_electron_density`/`fast_electron_density` (population=thermal/fast, populations.yml), two different segment kinds, while §6 offers only "required tokens per segment kind" (its own examples `population: [cold, hot]` and `aggregation: [total]` each name one kind) — under the natural conjunctive reading no single entry matches all three names, and §6's done-when tests neither a cross-kind union nor a multi-entry split

findings.reason: §2 already fixes imas-codex as the consumer that renders the returned entries, so naming the render site is a one-line clarification that does not move the mechanism.
findings.text: §6 says a `note` is "rendered after the documentation opening", but `select_conventions` (terms.py:250) has no caller in this repository outside its tests and ISN ships no documentation renderer that consumes `templates`, so the only named site that renders the note is §7's own test, and no production caller is named
